title: Feature Store Module Compiler
description: Compiles feature store definitions. Enforces typed feature definitions, TTL policies, point-in-time correctness for time-series joins, no feature bleed (future data in training), versioned feature groups, and backfill strategy documentation.

error_codes.FS002: Feature missing dtype or description — all features must be typed and documented
error_codes.FS003: Feature group missing version — use semantic versioning (v1, v2)
error_codes.FS004: No TTL (time-to-live) defined for feature group
error_codes.FS005: No event_timestamp for point-in-time correct joins — future features may leak
error_codes.FS006: Feature uses data from after prediction timestamp — feature bleed detected
